# federation-entity

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/openid-federation/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/federation-entity.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `federation-entity` component of `libs/openid-federation`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.federation`: generated from its catalogue, [federation-entity.json](../../libs/openid-federation/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/federation-entity.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_FEDERATION_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `FEDERATION`, `HOSTING` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHORS` (init-param `trustAnchorIssuers`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHORS`) | Unset; a list | This entity's superiors, space- or comma-separated Entity Identifiers, published as its authority_hints; with PingFederate's own issuer in the list it is an anchor instead and publishes trust_mark_issuers and trust_mark_owners. An anchor is recognised with or without a trailing slash, and whatever the case of its host | **Doesn't start**: Unset or blank, or an entry that is not an Entity Identifier (an https URL with a host and no query, fragment or user info): the federation servlet does not start, and the reason names the entry | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_SUBORDINATES` (init-param `subordinates`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_SUBORDINATES`) | Unset; a list | Entities this one vouches for, space- or comma-separated: /federation/fetch issues a statement about each with the keys its own configuration publishes, and /federation/list lists them | **Not checked**: A bad entry fails when it is fetched | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_SIGNING_ALG` (init-param `signingAlgorithm`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_SIGNING_ALG`) | `RS256`; one of `RS256`, `PS256` | How this entity signs its statements, with PingFederate's current RSA key | **Doesn't start**: Anything but RS256 or PS256, in any case: the federation servlet does not start | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_ORGANIZATION_NAME` (init-param `organizationName`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_ORGANIZATION_NAME`) | Unset | organization_name in this entity's federation_entity metadata | **Not checked**: Published as given | Any | No |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_CLIENT_REGISTRATION_TYPES` (init-param `clientRegistrationTypes`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_CLIENT_REGISTRATION_TYPES`) | `automatic,explicit`; a list | What client_registration_types_supported advertises, space- or comma-separated; none advertises neither and omits the registration endpoint, and federation_registration_endpoint is published only with explicit. Advertising only: registration works whatever it says | **Doesn't start**: A list of nothing, or none beside another word: the federation servlet does not start. Unknown words are published as given | Any | No |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLVE_DISCOVERY` (init-param `resolveDiscovery`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLVE_DISCOVERY`) | `known`; one of `known`, `any` | Who the resolve endpoint answers for: known, only this entity, its subordinates and the entities it hosts (18.1); any, anyone | **Doesn't start**: Anything but known or any, in any case: the federation servlet does not start | In production only as accepted risk `resolve-any`: `any` | Yes |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_ATTESTER_JWKS` (init-param `attesterJwks`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_ATTESTER_JWKS`) | Unset; a JSON object | The co-hosted attester's public keys, published as oauth_client_attester.jwks so other authorisation servers can trust its attestations through the federation | **Doesn't start**: Not one JSON object, not a JWK Set, or a key that is not public: the federation servlet does not start | Any | Yes |
| `corsEnabled` (init-param) | `true` | Whether every federation endpoint sends CORS headers | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, in any case: the federation servlet does not start (under development a spelling the reader before 0.6.0 took, such as yes, is read as it read it, false, with a warning) | Any | No |
| `corsAllowOrigin` (init-param) | `*` | Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the federation endpoints | **Not checked**: Sent as given | Any | No |
| `corsAllowMethods` (init-param) | `GET, OPTIONS` | Access-Control-Allow-Methods on the federation endpoints | **Not checked**: Sent as given | Any | No |
| `corsAllowHeaders` (init-param) | `Accept, Content-Type` | Access-Control-Allow-Headers on the federation endpoints | **Not checked**: Sent as given | Any | No |
| `corsMaxAge` (init-param) | `3600`; a whole number | Access-Control-Max-Age on the federation endpoints, in seconds | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number that fits an int: the federation servlet does not start | Any | No |
| `tokenEndpointAuthMethodsSupported` (init-param) | `private_key_jwt,attest_jwt_client_auth,attest_jwt_client_auth_dpop`; a list | token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported in the openid_provider metadata, space- or comma-separated | **Doesn't start**: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given | Any | No |
| `clientAttestationSigningAlgValuesSupported` (init-param) | `RS256,PS256,ES256`; a list | client_attestation_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, space- or comma-separated | **Doesn't start**: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given | Any | No |
| `clientAttestationPopSigningAlgValuesSupported` (init-param) | `ES256,RS256,PS256`; a list | client_attestation_pop_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, space- or comma-separated | **Doesn't start**: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given | Any | No |
| `dpopSigningAlgValuesSupported` (init-param) | `ES256,RS256,PS256`; a list | dpop_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, space- or comma-separated | **Doesn't start**: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given | Any | No |
| `clientAttestationFormatsSupported` (init-param) | `jwt`; a list | Read and kept, space- or comma-separated, and never published | **Doesn't start**: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise it has no effect | Any | No |
| `clientAttestationPopMethodsSupported` (init-param) | `attestation_pop_jwt,dpop_combined`; a list | The attestation proof-of-possession methods the openid_provider metadata advertises, space- or comma-separated | **Doesn't start**: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the federation servlet does not start. Otherwise published as given | Any | No |
| `attestationChallengeEndpointEnabled` (init-param) | `true` | Whether the openid_provider metadata advertises the attestation challenge endpoint | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, in any case: the federation servlet does not start (under development a spelling the reader before 0.6.0 took, such as yes, is read as it read it, false, with a warning) | Any | No |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_IGNORE_SSL_ERRORS` (init-param `ignoreSslErrors`, then system property `oidf.federation.ignore.ssl.errors`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_IGNORE_SSL_ERRORS`); superseded, still read: `OIDF_TRUST_CONTROLLER_IGNORE_SSL` (system property `oidf.trust.controller.ignore.ssl`, then env `OIDF_TRUST_CONTROLLER_IGNORE_SSL`) | `false` | Whether federation fetches skip certificate checks, for a test federation only: the federation servlet's own (resolve, Trust Mark status), registration's, the OGNL criteria's and attestation's, read as one setting by every one of them (F-0197). The federation servlet also reads its init-param ignoreSslErrors, first; PDP calls always check | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, in any case, or the superseded name set to a different value: the components that read it do not start (under development a spelling the reader before 0.6.0 took, such as yes, is read as it read it, false, with a warning) | Not in production: `true`; refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER`, `HOSTING` | Yes |
